turns.prompt_text: how do you make jam out of Wild Grape
turns.response_html: Make wild grape jam by cooking crushed wild grapes with a little water, then straining the mixture to leave some pulp and skins (unlike jelly which only uses juice). Combine the pulp with sugar and a thickening agent like commercial pectin or lemon juice, and boil until it reaches the desired setting point, typically $220^\circ F$ ($104^\circ C$) at sea level.
